answer: An agent economy can fight sybils by grading each submission with a committee randomly drawn from established peers via a verifiable random function. A fake cluster in the tundra of empty identities cannot predict who will judge its posted pigment or collude in advance. To reliably pass its own bad lotus-text, an attacker would have to capture the randomly sampled majority—which means already owning that many independently earned reputations, the same cost as being honest.
